column1: # TF claims of Lax et al. 2025 (Nature Communications 16:10277), Results, 'The fungal TF landscape', as tests on genus values. Group sets: Dikarya = Ascomycota + Basidiomycota; EDF = all phyla except Ascomycota, Basidiomycota and Microsporidia (the controller's reading of the paper, not a definition given by the paper); ALL = every phylum; 'X-Y' = set X without phylum Y.

# family = paper family (row name of MOESM3 'TF count', equal to paper_family in tf_family_map.tsv); BFD families are added through that map. metric: fraction (family proteins / all proteins), count, prevalence (share of genera with at least 1 protein), shannon (family is empty).

# The paper names the lineage but often not the comparison group. The comparison groups here (for example Dikarya for the lineage expansions) are the controller's choice and are in group_b. paper_direction: a>b, a<b, or absent_in_a (a expected below b).

# Extra metrics. rank (family empty): the Shannon index of group a is ranked among all phyla of group b with >= 5 genera and group a is tested against each of them (BH over the pairwise tests); yes only if group a ranks first and every pair is yes. max_other_prevalence: prevalence in group a against the highest prevalence among the other phyla with >= 5 genera; yes when the margin is >= 0.3 (EXCLUSIVE_MARGIN in tf_claims.py). The rows with '(pooled comparison)' in the text compare group a with the pooled other phyla and are kept; the rows ending in _highest and _max_other are the per-phylum versions.
# agrees = not comparable: BFD detects the family in fewer than 3 genera (MIN_NONZERO_GENERA), so the BFD Pfam definition does not reproduce the paper's family.

# Mucoromyceta rows (wrky_, e2f_, shannon_mucoromyceta): group a = Mucoromycota + Mortierellomycota + Glomeromycota together against all other phyla. This is an alternative reading of "Mucoromycota" in the paper (the paper may mean the three phyla together); it is an interpretation, not a fact. No threshold differs from the Mucoromycota rows.
